scenarios.title: R3: no energy today

surveyAnswers.text: I really do not have energy to work out today

assumptions: Calendar is assumed for the respondent's role (see the persona).
Day and time of the missed workout are assumed.

scenarios.userMessage: I really do not have energy to work out today

expected.notes: The respondent actually skipped. A good answer offers a gentler or shorter session, or moves it, not only rest.

scenarios.title: R5: kid is sick

surveyAnswers.text: Sorry my kid was sick so i need to take care of em

assumptions: Calendar is assumed for the respondent's role (see the persona).
Assumes caring for the child takes all of Tuesday.

scenarios.userMessage: Sorry my kid was sick so i need to take care of em

expected.notes: The respondent moved the workout. Move Tuesday's session to a later free day and keep the knee restriction (no leg exercises).

scenarios.title: R2: meeting at walk time

surveyAnswers.gotInTheWay: have a scheduled meeting conflicting with the workout scheduled

assumptions: Calendar is assumed for the respondent's role (see the persona).
The respondent's text was unusable, so the message is written from their 'what got in the way' answer. The meeting time is assumed.

scenarios.userMessage: I have a meeting at 6 tomorrow morning, same time as my walk.

expected.notes: The respondent moved it. Move or shorten Tuesday's walk around the meeting; no lifting or intense options.
